products.title: COWIN Xceed Dirtbike Wheel Upgrade Kit
products.description: Upgrade your ride with the Xceed Dirtbike Wheel Kit, designed for riders who demand flexibility, enhanced performance, and terrain-specific customization. By default, the Xceed dirtbike comes equipped with 19" front and rear wheels (70/100 - 19), but with this kit, you can unlock a range of wheel and tire combinations to match your riding style.Wheel Kit Options:Front Wheel Options:19" (70/100 - 19) – Balanced setup with solid traction and maneuverability; ideal for versatile off-road use.21" (2.75 - 21 / 80-90 - 21) – Larger diameter and narrower profile offer smoother handling and better obstacle clearance; perfect for high-speed trail riding and improved steering precision.Rear Wheel Options:16" (90/100 - 16) – Compact and wide, this setup delivers excellent grip and torque transfer, making it ideal for technical trails and aggressive acceleration.18" (90/100 - 18) – A versatile option that blends traction and ride comfort, suitable for a wide range of terrains.19" (70/100 - 19) – Stock configuration offering a balanced mix of responsiveness and agility.Each wheel set includes everything from tires, rim strips, rims, spokes, hubs, brake discs to sprockets — all matched and ready to go, ensuring durability, traction, and optimal performance in any terrain.
